- **Paper ids:** dr-dsn

## DSNet

- **Kind:** implementation
- **Url:** [url](https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet)
- **Provenance:** official
- **Attribution evidence:** Repository README identifies the method/dataset authors and links the corresponding paper: https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet/blob/1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89/README.md
- **Paper ids:** dsnet
- **Framework:** Python 3.6; torch 1.1.0; torchvision 0.3.0; torch-geometric 1.3.2; OR-Tools 8.0.8283
- **Version or commit:** 1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89
- **License:** MIT; vendored KTS has its own LICENSE.
- **Artifacts:** README links dataset zip plus anchor-based and anchor-free pretrained zips on Dropbox; alternate data mirrors; archive contents not downloaded. Data: https://www.dropbox.com/s/tdknvkpz1jp6iuz/dsnet_datasets.zip ; anchor-based: https://www.dropbox.com/s/0jwn4c1ccjjysrz/pretrain_ab_basic.zip ; anchor-free: https://www.dropbox.com/s/2hjngmb0f97nxj0/pretrain_af_basic.zip .
- **Feature schema:** Custom preprocessing: normalized GoogLeNet 1024-D vectors every sample_rate decoded frames (default 15), with KTS metadata in HDF5. This is 2 fps only for 30-fps media.
- **Evaluation notes:** Supervised detection model. anchor_based/train.py selects highest val_loader F1. Preserve NMS settings, prediction-to-shot conversion and split role.
- **Reproducibility:** Repository metadata, default-branch commit, README and listed source files inspected; no upstream environment installed, code executed, model loaded, or paper score reproduced.
- **Limitations:** Graph extension wheels tie to legacy PyTorch; raw-video tooling is useful but backbone/pooling/sampling must match an intended benchmark. Included upstream tests were inspected in tree, not run.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet/blob/1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89/README.md) · [source 2](https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet/blob/1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89/requirements.txt) · [source 3](https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet/blob/1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89/src/make_dataset.py) · [source 4](https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet/blob/1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89/src/helpers/video_helper.py) · [source 5](https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet/blob/1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89/src/helpers/vsumm_helper.py) · [source 6](https://github.com/li-plus/DSNet/blob/1804176e2e8b57846beb063667448982273fca89/src/anchor_based/train.py)

- **Url:** [url](https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG)
- **Provenance:** official
- **Attribution evidence:** Repository README identifies the method/dataset authors and links the corresponding paper: https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG/blob/32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247/README.md
- **Paper ids:** None
- **Framework:** Python 3.8; torch 2.0.1 in extensive requirements.txt
- **Version or commit:** 32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247
- **License:** MIT (GitHub license metadata).
- **Artifacts:** Author install/model pages link QFVS annotations, processed video features, text embeddings and downstream checkpoints via Google Drive; remote archives not downloaded. QFVS metadata: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18RpOVDrroY2gZ82ISObjAwWZz-i84XhD ; processed features: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PjFWGw35j6cePLuMdN30BP64dsxQm3sQ .
- **Feature schema:** QFVS HDF5 features plus seg_len; separate query embedding pickle and Tags.mat semantic tags. Do not assume interchangeability with SumMe HDF5.
- **Evaluation notes:** Official UniVTG implementation; derived implementation of QFVS protocol. QFVS uses weighted bipartite semantic matching, configurable top_percent; TVSum path is highlight detection and differs from generic F1 summarization.
- **Reproducibility:** Repository metadata, default-branch commit, README and listed source files inspected; no upstream environment installed, code executed, model loaded, or paper score reproduced.
- **Limitations:** Explicit .cuda() operations, Slurm-oriented scripts, commented config template, and large environment requirements. inference_qfvs.py trims video4 feature/tag length mismatch; original timeline needs audit.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG/blob/32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247/README.md) · [source 2](https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG/blob/32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247/install.md) · [source 3](https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG/blob/32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247/model.md) · [source 4](https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG/blob/32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247/requirements.txt) · [source 5](https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG/blob/32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247/eval/qfvs.py) · [source 6](https://github.com/showlab/UniVTG/blob/32659ac7aeba21742a63274f30eba785fc57e247/main/inference_qfvs.py)

## VASNet

- **Kind:** implementation
- **Url:** [url](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet)
- **Provenance:** official
- **Attribution evidence:** Repository README identifies the method/dataset authors and links the corresponding paper: https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/README.md
- **Paper ids:** vasnet
- **Framework:** Python 3.5.2; PyTorch 0.4.1; NumPy 1.16.1; h5py 2.8.0; OR-Tools 6.9.5824
- **Version or commit:** c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d
- **License:** MIT (GitHub license metadata).
- **Artifacts:** Both historical Box archive URLs in datasets_models_urls.txt were confirmed HTTP 404 by the external link audit on 2026-09-08; retained for provenance. No dataset/model archive body downloaded. Data: https://kingston.box.com/shared/static/zefb0i17mx3uvspgx70hovt9rr2qnv7y.zip ; weights: https://kingston.box.com/shared/static/2u2nqelxsptzefp1mno4z28kimmbljw2.zip .
- **Feature schema:** Inherited GoogLeNet HDF5 video groups and JSON train/test splits.
- **Evaluation notes:** Supervised MSE on gtscore. main.py evaluates self.test_keys every epoch, retains the best F1 epoch, and reports that maximum. SumMe max/TVSum average.
- **Reproducibility:** Repository metadata, default-branch commit, README and listed source files inspected; no upstream environment installed, code executed, model loaded, or paper score reproduced.
- **Limitations:** Dataset and pretrained-model Box archives confirmed missing (HTTP 404) on 2026-09-08; no replacement checkpoint verified. The test-named split is used for checkpoint selection: do not call that an untouched final test. Old CUDA9/PyTorch/OR-Tools dependencies; repeated random splits are not guaranteed disjoint folds.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/README.md) · [source 2](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/main.py) · [source 3](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/create_split.py) · [source 4](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/vsum_tools.py) · [source 5](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/datasets_models_urls.txt) · [source 6](https://github.com/ok1zjf/VASNet/blob/c3787531486f74789dc5e92758edf51e24f56e6d/vasnet_model.py)

## VideoXum / VTSUM-BLIP

- **Kind:** implementation
- **Url:** [url](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum)
- **Provenance:** official
- **Attribution evidence:** Repository README identifies the method/dataset authors and links the corresponding paper: https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/README.md
- **Paper ids:** videoxum
- **Framework:** Python 3.8; torch 1.10.1; torchvision 0.11.2; CUDA11.1; timm 0.4.12; transformers 4.15.0
- **Version or commit:** 11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df
- **License:** No root code license file found; separate HF dataset/model cards declare Apache-2.0; vendored evaluator has its own notices.
- **Artifacts:** Author HF listings expose annotation JSON, blip_feat.zip, vt_clip_feat.zip, vt_clip.pth, vtsum_tt.pth, vtsum_tt_ca.pth. Listings inspected; no blobs downloaded.
- **Feature schema:** JSON annotations use 1-fps timeline and ten vsum_onehot references. BLIP .npz uses features; VT-CLIP .npz uses vision and text; inspect actual feature dimensions before use.
- **Evaluation notes:** Supervised visual/text summarization. utils.get_top15_frames selects scores >= sorted_scores[floor(.15*N)], giving one extra item for unique scores and more under ties. Rank metrics use the ten-reference mean; F1 retains mean/max.
- **Reproducibility:** Repository metadata, default-branch commit, README and listed source files inspected; no upstream environment installed, code executed, model loaded, or paper score reproduced.
- **Limitations:** requirements.txt is partial; configs require separate BLIP/VT-CLIP checkpoints. Dataset loader pads/truncates to max_frames (512 default) and can truncate mismatched timelines; record evaluated length.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
- **Sources:** [source 1](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/README.md) · [source 2](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/requirements.txt) · [source 3](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/configs/vtsum_blip_tt.yaml) · [source 4](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/data/activitynet_dataset.py) · [source 5](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/eval_v2vt_sum.py) · [source 6](https://github.com/jylins/videoxum/blob/11bd4fe3fb51b7dc804dd1519a4914f67bff60df/utils.py)

## vsLSTM / dppLSTM

- **Kind:** implementation
- **Url:** [url](https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM)
- **Provenance:** official
- **Attribution evidence:** Repository README identifies the method/dataset authors and links the corresponding paper: https://github.com/kezhang-cs/Video-Summarization-with-LSTM/blob/0ee0a0948872544567ecede76868287042470f75/README.md
- **Paper ids:** lstm-dpp
- **Framework:** Python 2.7+, Theano 0.7+, MATLAB
- **Version or commit:** 0ee0a0948872544567ecede76868287042470f75
- **License:** LICENSE.md states CC-BY without a version; metadata restricted to research purposes; original dataset rights separate.
- **Artifacts:** models/model_trained_SumMe and models/model_trained_TVSum present in GitHub tree; binary weights not downloaded. README data download anchor lacks an actual URL; data/README.md contains extraction instruction only.
- **Feature schema:** 2-fps GoogLeNet pool5; HDF5 idx, fea_i, gt_1_i, gt_2_i schema, not the later video_i/features schema.
- **Evaluation notes:** Supervised comparator. MATLAB wrapper reports SumMe max-user F1; released evaluate_TVSum.m uses 0.18 for reference budget despite 15% paper convention.
- **Reproducibility:** Repository metadata, default-branch commit, README and listed source files inspected; no upstream environment installed, code executed, model loaded, or paper score reproduced.
- **Limitations:** Legacy Theano/MATLAB environment; advertised data download is incomplete. Do not treat weights in the tree as validated inference.
- **Verified on:** 2026-09-08
